selector.rationale: Decreased T1 signal and increased T2 and STIR signal at L4–L5 on MRI, along with lumbar spinal tenderness, fever, and Enterobacter cloacae in blood cultures, support Spondylodiscitis as the most likely diagnosis

rejected.label: Osteomyelitis
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to Spondylodiscitis

rejected.label: Enterobacter cloacae infection
rejected.why: While Enterobacter cloacae is present in blood cultures, it is more likely a cause of the Spondylodiscitis rather than the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Anastomotic fistula
rejected.why: Already being treated and not directly related to the new symptoms of low back pain and fever
